::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 12th 1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 102-103
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

Many thanks for your prompt response which relieves me of a good deal of worry.[^1]

Yes there are two short stories to be recovered from America, about the length of the Ghost. One I make sure of in a month or six weeks, the other must depend on the civility of [Perry Mason](organizations/other_249.qmd).[^2]

They would both come at the end being modern, but if I need write any more to make up the set, I should know in time, as my present ideas are of the historical order

With many thanks

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: She had asked for an advance of money in her previous letter.
[^2]: CMY was assembling the stories which were republished as *Bye-Words* (1880).
